weighting: uniform allocations within each visible position, then equal weight per position; no stock
limitations: Response categories are post-action mediators and not causal controls. Hidden allocation uniformity ignores earlier observed opponent choices; model-only bot continuations; assumed branch opening; block winner unassigned; first-eligible selection; position CIs exploratory.
next: independent-seed replication and category-conditioned finish analysis, especially forced passes vs changed reply tiles; inspect four-end changes without assuming causal independence.

replication.note: Two disjoint 30-position samples; no pooled world-weighting; prior values rounded for min-hand-pips/fast-doubles; see original run JSON for exact prior metrics.

newFinding: Independent 30-position exact-allocation replication: connector X-Y versus unrelated equal-pip single loses about 15.9 pp finish-first under closed-branch-control and min-hand-pips, but is approximately neutral against fast-doubles. This is model-specific and not a general rule.
confidence: Direction replicated on independent selected deals under two continuation policies; position-level exploratory CI excludes 0 for these two; no multiplicity adjustment, bot and first-eligible selection confounding; no human-play causal claim.
exactNextHypothesisAction: Implement a category-conditioned paired-world audit of first-opponent forced pass vs different-tile response, and measure four-branch end changes; pre-register contrasts and replicate on new seeds. Do not treat response categories as randomized causes.
